title: Argentina briefly closes Iguazu Falls to tourists over El Niño
summary: Fear of overflowing rivers forced Argentine authorities to temporarily block tourist access to the breathtaking Iguazu Falls on Monday, attributing rising water levels to the El Niño weather pattern.
